record.body:
## Description

Replace the Evidence tab OptionList with a DataTable matrix, release line, and the main-screen requirement glyph strip.

## Approach

1. Rebuild EvidencePane with release_line above a DataTable keyed by requirement id; keep integration panel below (R3,R6).
2. Drop columns by width per matrix_columns (R5); Enter opens RequirementDetailScreen (R4).
3. Append strip glyphs after the R tally in selector_segments with click meta evidence:<phase> routed to action_open_phase(evidence) (R7).
4. Cover with tests/test_dashboard_phase_screen.py at 100, 55, and 40 columns.

payload.title: Evidence matrix DataTable and main-screen strip
